files.text:
title: "MCP Google Docs Editor (BDD fixture stub)"
summary: "Synthetic product document for BDD fixtures — deliberately minimal."

roles:
  - name: Claude User
    definition: "An individual who uses Claude Desktop or Claude Web App and wants to work on their Google Docs through natural language commands"
    primary_use_case: "Document reading and editing through a conversational AI interface"
    characteristics:
      - "Non-technical users focused on content creation and editing"

vocabulary:
  forbidden_qualifiers:
    - properly
    - correctly
    - appropriate
    - user-friendly
    - fast
  forbidden_actions:
    - name: "handle"
      reason: "Hides what the system observably does with the input."
      replacement: "Name the observable action: displays, returns, lists, rejects."

glossary:
  - term: Google Doc
    means: >-
      A document in the Claude User's Google Drive, the thing every
      request names.
  - term: outline
    means: >-
      The document's headings, in document order, as Claude lists them
      in the conversation.

concepts:
  given:
    - concept: shared document
      means: >-
        A Google Doc set up for a role's account: either it holds a stated
        number of headings, "no" meaning none, and is shared with that
        account, or that account cannot open it.
      terms: [Google Doc]
  when:
    - concept: outline request
      means: A role asks Claude, in the conversation, for the outline of the Google Doc.
      terms: [Google Doc, outline]
  then:
    - concept: reply
      means: >-
        Claude's reply in the conversation either lists exactly a stated
        number of headings, in document order, is exactly a stated
        message, or offers to summarise the Google Doc instead.
      terms: [Google Doc, outline]
